results.title: cloth, mummy
results.description: cloth, mummy. Fragment of mummy cloth and head casing. Painted blue, yellow and red on outside. "cloth is coarse weave linen dyed with henna. cartonnage is built up with multiple layers of coarse linen moulded to shape of head [?] part of mummy covering. Plastered with crude gypsum plaster on which a further linen layer has been fixed. Then plastered with a finer grade of gypsum plaster on which the decoration in yellow, red and blue-green in that order has been painted. The broad area of blue-green may be part of the wig. Late Dynastic period."- Eric Young, 10/3/70. String around objects holds .1 and .2 together.

results.title: Egyptian mummies
results.description: "Lavishly illustrated throughout with vibrant images of Egyptian life and afterlife, Egyptian Mummies offers an illuminating guide to the ever-fascinating topic of Egyptian mummies.. The author, a world authority on the subject, asks and answers all the most intriguing questions about Egyptian mummies; how and why they were made, who and what was preserved, which religious beliefs and sacred rituals lay behind the cult, and what fabulous treasures and tombs were created for the Egyptian afterlife.. Drawing not only on the ancient evidence, but also on recent research and scientific findings, the book offers a stimulating overview of our current understanding, emphasising the role of mummies in expanding our knowledge of ancient cultures."--Publisher's information.. Includes bibliographical references (page 155) and index.

results.title: mummy Souser-iret-binet; Sarcophagus
results.description: mummy. Mummy, female (Souser-iret-binet 27-35 yrs) probably Lower Egyptian family. Obtained from Canterbury Museum in 1957. Mummy is from Akhmim, Egypt. CT scanned in 2002, and xrayed in 1970?ish. Four year conservation project carried out in early 2000s. Radiocarbon dates obtained on linen wrappings, with date range of 850-575 BCE i.e. mid-late Third Intermediate Period to early Late Period..

results.title: Statuette
results.description: statuette. Wooden statuette of a mummy. The bottom of the statuette has a extrusion which would be used for placement. Paint remains around the mummy. Painted on necklaces can be seen across the breast. The hair has a blue painted border. The face is green, representing death. On the back and sides a net-design is painted, possibly representing net clothing. The base has three painted lines running parallel around it. 309 is written on the back. Provenance beyond Saqqara is unknown..
